features.text: Advanced sling and swathe design provides complete shoulder immobilization for optimal healing
Universal sizing with adjustable straps ensures a perfect fit for all body types
Dual-function support system maintains arm position while reducing strain on the shoulder complex
Breathable, lightweight materials offer extended wearing comfort during recovery
Ambidextrous design fits both left and right shoulders with equal effectiveness

measurement: For optimal support and comfort, refer to our sizing chart or visit our Perfect Fit Promise page. Our universal sizing accommodates most body types, ensuring proper immobilization and therapeutic benefits throughout your recovery journey.
